title: WorkPacket
description: Versioned dispatch contract (FR-2) for any role handed work by a coordinator, runtime-neutral. Contract version work-packet.v1. Formalises the fields already carried informally in Claude Code agent dispatch prompts; does not replace those prompts.
$comment: Required set kept minimal (spec §12.A Chunk A1) so existing Claude Code dispatches map cleanly without every field being mandatory up front. role/runtime are additive fields recording the target role (per references/runtime-roles.md, when introduced) and the runtime executing it (e.g. claude-code, openclaw).

feature_slug.description: Kebab-case build slug, matching the build-status.schema.json slug pattern.

objective.description: Bounded statement of what this dispatch must accomplish.

governing_artefacts.description: Paths to the spec, plan, or other artefacts governing this dispatch.

execution_policy.description: Capability-REMOVING policy for this dispatch. Every field narrows what the executing role may do; no field can grant an authority the role did not already have. Absence of the object means no policy was declared, which is NOT the same as unrestricted — see references/execution-policy.md. A bare {} is invalid because it cannot be distinguished from an authoring mistake.
execution_policy.$comment: This shape is duplicated between work-packet.schema.json (properties.execution_policy) and completion-packet.schema.json (definitions.executionPolicy) because validate-packet.mjs compiles each packet schema standalone with no addSchema, so a cross-file $ref would fail to resolve, be swallowed by the compile try/catch, and silently degrade that packet to the structural floor. validate-packet.test.mjs asserts every shared key stays identical and that allowed_files — folded into the echo so it is self-contained — is the only permitted divergence.

write_scope.description: Repo-relative glob patterns this dispatch may write. Conjunctive with allowed_files: a path must match BOTH when both are present. An empty array means nothing is writable.

protected_paths.description: Repo-relative glob patterns that must never be written, overriding allowed_files and write_scope.

egress_allowlist.description: Permitted egress hosts. Only meaningful with network_egress: allowlist.

deploy_authority.description: The only expressible value is false. A policy can withhold deploy authority but can never confer it; deployment stays operator-owned.

expires_at.description: Instant after which this policy must not be honoured. Expiry is evaluated at dispatch time by the coordinator, not by this schema.

role.description: Runtime-neutral role name (e.g. builder, reviewer, architect) per references/runtime-roles.md.
